answer_1.quote: We perform extensive experiments to demonstrate the universal susceptibility of PE in LLMs, considering two settings: rich-resource and few-shot... We choose three text classification datasets, including SST-2, OLID, and AG's News datasets.

answer_2.quote: We use four metrics: Normal Clean Accuracy (NCA), Prompt Clean Accuracy (PCA), Clean Accuracy (CA), Attack Success Rate (ASR).

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-NEO as the backbone of the text classification model to map an input sentence to a feature vector, then pass to a feedforward neural network layer.

answer_4.quote: The results are presented in tables reporting NCA, PCA, CA, and ASR; no human annotators or crowdsourcing are mentioned.
